entities.summary: Darren Morningstar is an American former professional basketball player who was selected by the Boston Celtics in the second round of the 1992 NBA draft. A 6'10" and 325 lb center, Morningstar played in only one NBA season, splitting time with the Dallas Mavericks and Utah Jazz. He played college basketball for the Navy Midshipmen and Pittsburgh Panthers.
